author: More Perfect Union
description:
The Trump administration is moving to build data centers on public lands.

We went to Idaho, where a 4 million sqf data center is proposed on federal lands in order to get around local opposition.

The community is being steamrolled, people are worried about their power bills, and Independent Senate candidate Todd Achilles wants to shut it down.

Producer/Host: @gabriella.spielberg 
Editor: @kungaaaaaaaa
Videographer: Mike Wynn
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Trump has set aside 17,000 acres of public land for data centers

author: More Perfect Union
description:
A Texas billionaire is trying to take $250 million from a local school system to fund a hockey stadium.

Tom Gaglardi owns the Dallas Stars, and to build their new arena he wants to take money from Plano schools.

That's after getting a separate $700 million in public funds
Producers: Michael Mockler, Victoria Hammett
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
Editor: Joseph Howard
title: This Texas billionaire is trying to take $250 MILLION from local schools
